description: List replies to a specific comment. The interaction_id must be a comment ID starting with sapi_cmt_ (from social_api_get_comments). Returns reply interaction objects in the same format. Supports pagination via cursor and since filter. Max 100 results (default 20). Supported on Instagram and Facebook.

interaction_id.description: Comment interaction ID (must start with sapi_cmt_)

name: social_api_get_comment_replies
title: Get Comment Replies
